title: THE ROAD THAT DOES NOT END
logline: شش غریبه در یک دشت طوفانی به هم می‌رسند، هر کدام چیزی را جا گذاشته‌اند؛ فیلم دربارهٔ همان یک شب است.
format: silent anime, 10 minutes, 8 scenes, no dialogue (title cards only)
rule: صامت است — پس نه VO، نه لب‌سینک. تیتر جای دیالوگ.

scenes.title: the road
beats: a boot steps into a puddle, the reflection breaks
the road runs to the horizon, empty
rin stands at the edge of the frame, coat pulled sideways by wind
he looks back the way he came
far off: a single light
the wind takes his hair across his eyes
he starts walking, the road tilting past the frame
a title card: 'the road that does not end'
the light is closer now, and it is not a light
he stops, and the wind stops with him

scenes.title: the knight
beats: a spear plants itself in the ground, taller than the frame
sera stands with her weight on one leg, armour wet
she looks down at rin from the top of the frame
rin's hand moves to his belt and stops
her gauntlet closes around the spear shaft
the two of them in one frame, a wide gap between
she turns her back, which is an answer
the spear comes out of the mud with a sound we do not hear
she walks, and the road takes her
rin follows, four steps behind

scenes.title: the coat
beats: a coat hangs over a broken wall, empty
mira sits under it, knees to her chest
she does not look up when he arrives
rin crouches, hat in his hands
the coat flaps once, against the wind, not with it
she says nothing, and the frame holds on her hands
he puts something down on the wall, out of frame
she looks at it, and then at him
the wall is between them for one more shot
she stands, the coat going back over her shoulders

scenes.title: the blade
beats: a blade, held low, catching the last light
kae waits, ponytail moving once
the gate behind her is taller than the frame
she lifts the blade ten centimetres and stops
a bird crosses the frame, and she does not follow it
the blade goes back into the sash
she turns her head, side glance, one eye
her hand rests on the hilt, not holding it
she bows, barely, and the frame cuts her at the waist
the gate is empty in the next frame

scenes.title: the courier
beats: a satchel is set down on a table, too carefully
yuna's hands are shaking, and she hides them
the window behind her is the brightest thing in the film
she looks at the door, then away
she takes one letter out and does not open it
her shoulders drop
the paper is folded once, then again
she puts it back, and her hand stays in the satchel
a step outside, off frame
she stands up straight, as if nothing happened

scenes.title: the fire
beats: five figures around a fire, none of them looking at each other
the fire is the only warm colour in the frame
sera's armour reflects the flames and she does not like it
mira's coat is spread on the floor like a stain
kae sits furthest away, blade across her knees
yuna's satchel is on her lap, hands on top of it
rin looks at each of them in turn, one shot each
nobody speaks, and the fire moves instead
a log collapses, and everyone flinches
the frame holds on the fire after everyone has left

scenes.title: the storm
beats: rain hits the ground so hard it bounces
rin stands in it, arms out, face up
sera watches from under the gate, unreadable
the wind takes her hair and she lets it
he shouts something we do not hear
she does not move, and that is an answer
lightning makes the frame white for one shot
in the white, only their outlines
the rain stops as suddenly as it started
the silence after is the loudest thing in the film

scenes.title: the road again
beats: the road at dawn, empty in both directions
rin's boots, walking, the mud different from scene 1
he stops in the same place he started
the light in the distance is gone
he looks back once, and there is nobody
a coat, folded, on the broken wall
he picks it up, holds it, puts it on
the road tilting past the frame, the same angle as scene 1
title card: 'the road does not end. you do.'
the frame holds empty, then cuts to black
